title: Hand of the Isle component diagram
description: The game and what serves it. godot/ is the Godot 4 project: main.tscn runs Main (scripts/main.gd), which owns the camera, the interface and one World at a time; the World owns the terrain and the units, and RivalAI drives a deity through the same World.cast rules the player uses. The Worker serves the landing page and the web export only to holders of games:hand-of-the-isle. The scripts' class diagram and Main state diagram are in games/hand-of-the-isle/godot/scripts/.dev/.

components.name: Main
components.responsibility: Scene dressing (sky, sun, sea), input, the cursor, the game states and the command-line test switches.

components.name: Simulation
components.responsibility: World, Terrain, Settlement and Walker: the heightmap, homes, followers, combat, faith, influence and the eight powers.

components.name: Rival deity
components.responsibility: RivalAI: sculpts inside its own influence, picks its followers' behaviour and casts powers, paying faith like the player.

components.name: Camera and interface
components.responsibility: CameraRig (orbiting tabletop camera) and Hud (faith, follower balance, power bar, behaviour switch, notices, title, help and end screens).

components.name: Hand of the Isle Worker
components.responsibility: Serves every file only to signed-in players holding games:hand-of-the-isle, and joins the engine's parts (worker/index.ts).

components.name: Landing and play pages
components.responsibility: The landing page, the play page's stylesheet and boot script, the icon and the Content-Security-Policy (web/), around Godot's export (godot/web_shell/shell.html).

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Who is signed in and which roles they hold; declares games:hand-of-the-isle.

relationships.description: Creates a World per match, steps it and casts the player's powers through World.cast.
Ticks the rival, and a stand-in for the player on the title screen and in autoplay.
Moves the camera and updates the interface; reacts to its signals.
Reads the World and acts only through World.cast and World.behavior.
Hud reads faith and follower counts and the POWERS table.
Service binding ACCOUNTS, through vendor/icelander-auth: every file needs games:hand-of-the-isle.
Serves the pages from the static assets.
The play page starts the Godot web export (boot.js).
